"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    # NFKD splits accented letters into base letter + combining mark; drop the marks.
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF
cat > textutil/truncate.py <<'EOF'
"""Text truncation for previews."""

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - len(ELLIPSIS)
    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:max(limit, 0)]
    # If the cut lands exactly on a word end (next char is whitespace), keep the whole prefix.
    if text[budget].isspace():
        head = text[:budget]
    else:
        head = text[:budget]
        cut = max(head.rfind(" "), head.rfind("\t"), head.rfind("\n"))
        if cut == -1:
            # A single word longer than the budget: no full word fits, so hard-cut it.
            head = head
        else:
            head = head[:cut]
    return head.rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
EOF

    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:max(limit, 0)]
    head = text[:budget]
    # If the next character is whitespace, the cut already falls on a word end.
    if not text[budget].isspace():
        cut = max(head.rfind(" "), head.rfind("\t"), head.rfind("\n"))
        if cut != -1:
            head = head[:cut]
        # Otherwise a single word exceeds the budget; hard-cut it as the only option.
    return head.rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
